name: Hostel — lobby & corridor loop
description: Real capture with the team's PoseCam app (Nothing Phone A059, ARCore poses). Geometry from per-frame metric depth (1,376 frames) placed with ARCore's metric poses; depth scale fixed by triangulation against the poses; the walked path counts as observed floor. Viewable as sharp points (default) or as oriented surface discs (surfels) that read as continuous walls and floors.
